note: The Firebliss Range's four oases as CANDIDATE sites for a player settlement (PLAN.md section 6). The open world's outpost registry (KOUTPOST, being built as core work on claude/outpost-registry-6c40e9; its README gives the shape this file should follow and this file is written ahead of it: check the field names against openworld/outposts/README.md when it is merged) may read these as hints. No spot is picked for the player and nothing is drawn on the ground for them. NPC places stay out of the registry: the hunters' camps here are core/camp's, not candidates. Values: px the valley's tarn on scale model 5.1; level the tarn's (the model's wl); warmth the model's mean temperature off the land cells round it (degC); the hazards' words are the plan's (section 5) and the station pages' records.
